C0.loc: Section 2.1 Bipartite Tournaments, p. 1237; also Abstract and Section 1, p. 1236
C0.quote: Given a tournament K, our goal is to place a ranking
C0.note: The paper ranks the players of bipartite tournaments (e.g. students vs exam questions, golfers vs courses) from binary match results via chain editing. The input is a matrix of match outcomes between players, not inputs of several agents aggregated by voting; voting is mentioned only as an application area of ordinary tournaments and in related work. This is tournament ranking / paired comparisons analysis, so coding stops at C0.
